newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AECI to place shares after Afex unbundling.
newsitem.headline: AECI to place shares after Afex unbundling.

text.p: South African chemicals group AECI Ltd said on Tuesday it would proceed with a scheme to unbundle Afex Holdings (Pty) Ltd to realise its investment.
The unbundling will be accomplished by way of the voluntary liquidation of holding company Afex.

"In terms of the scheme the liquidator of Afex will mandate Goldman Sachs International and Casenove & Co as joint lead managers, to place approximately 12 percent of the issued share capital of the company, currently held by Afex, by way of a combined domestic and international placement," a statement said.

Major shareholder Anglo American Industrial Corp Ltd (Amic) will maintain its effective interest in AECI after the placement at 52.6 percent and will buy some 13 percent of the issued share capital from the liquidator at the placement price.
The net proceeds of the placement of the AECI shares and the sale to Amic will be distributed to AECI as a liquidation dividend.
The remaining shares in AECI currently owned by Afex, representing 25 percent of issued share capital, will be distributed to Amic as a liquidation dividend.
Analysts have favoured the unbundling of Afex to free up capital and boost liquidity.
